name: kotlin_css_specificity
description: Kotlin CSS specificity fixture exercising selector scanning, token flushing, pseudo/class/id branches, and weighted scoring.

exports.name: cssSpecificScore
exports.description: Runs the css specific scenario to exercise this fixture's representative Kotlin code path.

exports.name: cssElementScore
exports.description: Runs the css element scenario to exercise this fixture's representative Kotlin code path.

exports.name: cssIdScore
exports.description: Runs the css id scenario to exercise this fixture's representative Kotlin code path.

exports.name: _start
exports.description: Kotlin/Wasm runtime entry export generated by the library binary; corpus tests call the explicit score exports instead.

tests.notes: CSS specificity scenarios: score complex selector; score element-only selector; score id-only selector.

steps.notes: Scans a selector with id, class, attribute, pseudo-class, and element tokens; the result encodes CSS specificity.
Exercises token flushing for a descendant selector containing only element names.
Exercises the id branch with no class or descendant components.

source.description: AI-authored Kotlin source compiled with Kotlin/Wasm wasmWasi production library output to represent Kotlin compiler lowering in the corpus.

notes: AI-authored Kotlin/Wasm fixture compiled from Kotlin source with the wasmWasi production library target. The optional random_get import is used by Kotlin runtime hashing; the fixture stubs it to return success with zeroed entropy so HashMap-related behavior is deterministic.
